reviews.text: Our experience with Barbara was very positive. She was very attentive and flexible with scheduling. This summer we left our dog with her for two days (he's not an easy dog ​​to care for) and he was very happy with her. We're very pleased. If we can, we'll definitely use her again.

She's a delight. My dog ​​went with her without hesitation and came back even better. She and her partner are a 10 out of 10. On top of that, she donated some of her earnings to the Venezuelan earthquake relief effort. You can't get more hearty than that.
Thank you so much for your rating!!✨🐾 …

We are so happy. Barbara has been taking care of Berta since day one. She's always available, sending us daily photos of our puppy.
We wouldn't trade her for anything.
Thank you!!

My puppy has been going to Barbara's doggy daycare for a few months now, and we're absolutely thrilled! Just seeing how happy she is when she sees Barbara is a sign of how well she takes care of her. 🥰 She adapts perfectly to the very special needs a puppy of just a few months old might have! Plus, she sends me photos and keeps me updated on everything. We recommend Barbara 100%!
Thank you! Very nice service, my dog loved her, and greeted her everytime with excitement and joy <3

I left my dog ​​with Barbara for a whole day to see how she'd do, and it went very well. She came out calm and kept sending me photos and videos to let me know how she was doing. I'll definitely do it again.

Barbara was amazing with our little guy. It was my First time leaving Alfred behind while out of town and she took such great care of him. She made the entire process so easy. She sent photo updates as well so it made us being gone a little less stressful. I would 100% recommend her to anybody and will be utilizing her services whenever we need to head out of town again.

Barbara was absolutely wonderful with our 4-month-old Winston! 🐾 From the moment we met her, we knew he was in caring and loving hands. She kept us updated regularly with messages and photos, which gave us so much peace of mind. Winston had the best time socialising with the other dogs she was caring for, made new little friends, and clearly adored Barbara. He looked so happy, relaxed, and completely at home with her. We couldn’t have asked for a better pet sitter and would trust her again anytime. Highly recommended! ❤️

Honestly, he's given me so much confidence that I've never...
His manner, his sweetness, and even his voice! He's a delight and keeps sending me photos and calls to put my mind at ease! Thank you, thank you, thank you!
